name: EH3D-CORE-LIBS
notes: Scaffolding v0.0.1: tolerant readers of Gerber RS-274X layers, Excellon drill files and G-code (a modal interpreter for the GRBL, Marlin and PlanetCNC dialects) that never panic and report what they could not understand as diagnostics with line numbers. They draw nothing, compute no toolpath and have not been tried on a collection of real production files; HP-GL and 2D geometry are planned. Nothing here has been run on a machine.
